created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the settings document this group uses was first stored, in RFC 3339 format. This can be earlier than when the group got its settings, and it changes if the group gets a different document.

rbac_group_status.description: Whether the group is still one of the organization's RBAC Groups. Its `type` is `active` if it is, `deleted` if it is not, and `unknown` if that cannot be checked right now. A deleted group's settings stay in `rbac_group_order` but match no member.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When this group's settings or its position in the order last changed, in RFC 3339 format. Its position changes whenever the number of groups ahead of it changes.
